_hint: Kaan's QoL (server part). Takes effect on the next server start, no rebuild needed. balsamDuration: minutes = how long Golden Star Balm effects last, effects = which damage effects get that duration. allExtracts: makes every extract always reachable (chance 100 %, all entry points, time windows open; trains stay excluded). noQuestFailures: quests no longer fail by playing (kills, death, reputation, time limits); story branches (quest-vs-quest, dialogue choices) are kept on purpose. Set enabled to false to switch it off. exceptions = quest ids or internal names that are not touched; liftSingleRaid / noWaitTimes are extra and off by default.
